text:
kevin: quick follow-up from the cross-chart prototype review. users expect the p95 crosshair to stick across the sparkline, heatmap and waterfall when scrubbed, but right now it only pins on the sparkline. recording: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/crosshair-sync :eyes:
maya: saw that too. design intent was sticky crosshair, but the heatmap renders at different bucket boundaries sometimes. UX question: if exact timestamp isn't available in a chart, should we snap to nearest bucket or show a transient ghost crosshair?
jon: engineering take: snapping to nearest bucket is much easier and less janky. show a ghost shimmer on charts where exact match wasn't found and expose `snap: nearest` in ARIA description for screen readers. also avoid remounting crosshair DOM on each frame to keep focus stable.
sam: a11y: voiceover users need clear context: when crosshair moves, announce "p95 at 13:42: 243ms, cross-chart synced" unless the target chart snapped, then say "snapped to nearest bucket". add aria-live polite and debounce to avoid noise while scrubbing.
tara: microcopy: in the tooltip, replace ambiguous "delta" with explicit "change vs baseline" and show both absolute and pct: "p95: 243 ms (+14% vs baseline)". also add a tiny info icon that opens a one-line explainer.
kevin: mobile concern: scrubbing with thumb on mini-map often hides the tooltip under the finger. maybe we should offset the tooltip above finger or use a translucent popover pinned to top of card. thoughts?
maya: prefer offset popover. make it anchored to the top of the card on touchmove and add a small caret pointing to the scrubbed x. respect `pointer-event: none` on the caret so the finger doesn't block input.
jon: perf note from perf-bot: "heatmap crosshair sync adds 18ms median paint on dense dashboards". suggestion: throttle cross-chart updates to animation frame and coalesce multiple inputs. also only update DOM attributes that changed (avoid setting style every frame).
perf-bot: trace link: https://perf.redwood.com/trace/4892  shows layout paint on heatmap canvas when we toggle crosshair highlight.
sam: keyboard flows: when you keyboard-focus the sparkline and press right/left to move crosshair, focus must remain on the sparkline, not jump to tooltip. screen reader should be able to use arrow keys to drag the crosshair and Enter to lock it. locked state should set `aria-pressed` or `aria-live` announcement "Crosshair locked at 243ms".
jon: implementation detail: use roving focus for handles and keep a focused element that receives arrow key events. on Enter we set a `data-locked=true` attribute and add a persistent highlight class. unlocking returns focus to the handle.
maya: visual affordance: when locked, show a small lock icon in the tooltip and add a subtle glow to the p95 value. copy for the lock tooltip: "Locked crosshair preserves selection across sampling & time-range changes."
tara: sampling interplay: if user locks crosshair then switches sampling presets, we must remap the locked x to the new domain. if remap fails show a snackbar: "Selection preserved where possible; if buckets changed significantly it may snap. [View details]". the '[View details]' link should open a lightweight panel explaining bucket remapping.
sam: accessibility for remap snackbar: announce changes with polite aria-live and include a keyboard-focusable link. ensure snackbars don't steal focus.
jon: propose algorithm: store normalized position (0..1) when locking, then after preset swap compute new x by applying normalized position to new scale, then snap to nearest bucket if necessary. do remap on a worker if hist size > 50k to avoid main thread stalls.
kevin: small CSS example for tooltip offset on mobile:
```css
.card .tooltip.touch-popover { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; }
```
perf-bot: recommended debounce: coalesce crosshair move events to RAF and throttle aria announcements to 400ms.
maya: accessibility nit: when crosshair is locked, add `aria-describedby` pointing to a hidden element describing remap behavior and what "locked" means. string: "Crosshair locked. Selection will persist when changing sampling or time range where possible."
tara: copy tweak: change the time-range scrubber label from "Range" to "Time range (brush)" to reduce confusion with duration labels. also change the toggle label from "Sync crosshair" to "Sync charts" for clarity.
kevin: owners: jon (lock + remap algorithm + worker), sam (voiceover strings + keyboard flows), maya (visual lock affordance + tooltip offsets), tara (snackbar copy + explainer panel), perf-bot (trace+recommendations). I'll open parent ticket and link mocks. acceptance criteria: crosshair sticks logically across charts, keyboard flows do not lose focus, locked selection persists across sampling and time-range changes (or explains why it couldn't), and no measurable stall on dense dashboards.
jon: i'll add e2e: focus sparkline -> arrow right 10x -> Enter to lock -> change sampling to 5% -> assert crosshair still visible and p95 value consistent (within snap tolerance).
sam: i'll run VO/NVDA after PR and provide final strings.
maya: thanks team  closing thread for async work. :white_check_mark:
